# wallix-bastion_encryption (Data Source)

Get the current disk encryption status of the WALLIX Bastion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Check whether Bastion disk encryption is currently enabled
data "wallix-bastion_encryption" "current" {}

output "encryption_enabled" {
  value = data.wallix-bastion_encryption.current.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `encryption_mode` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `seal_state` (String)

## Usage Notes

### No Lookup Key

The `wallix-bastion_encryption` data source is a **singleton**: encryption configuration is a
single, global setting on the Bastion, not a collection of named objects. Because of this, the
data source takes **no arguments at all** - there is no `authentication_name`, `domain_name`, or
similar lookup key to provide. Simply declare the data source with an empty block, as shown above.

### Passphrase Is Never Readable

The encryption passphrase configured via the `wallix-bastion_encryption` resource is
**write-only**. The Bastion API never returns it, and this data source has no field for it. There
is no way - via this data source, the resource, or the underlying API - to retrieve the currently
configured passphrase. Attempting to "read back" the passphrase from Terraform is not possible;
you must keep the passphrase in your own secret management system if you need to know its value.

### Attributes

- **enabled** (Boolean): whether the encryption has been set up on the Bastion, sealed or not.
- **seal_state** (String): `need_setup` (the encryption was never set up), `sealed` (set up, but
  the Bastion waits for its passphrase, for example after a reboot) or `unsealed` (ready for use).
- **encryption_mode** (String): `need_setup`, `unprotected` (no passphrase), `passphrase`, or
  `[hidden]` when the API user can't read it.

Use them to gate other resources or checks on the encryption state, without needing to know or
manage the passphrase itself:

```terraform
locals {
  encryption_set_up = data.wallix-bastion_encryption.current.enabled
  bastion_unsealed  = data.wallix-bastion_encryption.current.seal_state == "unsealed"
}
```
